scenario: Same saved room: 3 dolls, 10 furniture items. Camera pans for the first 10 seconds of each minute; remaining time idle. Both runs last at least 11 minutes. No saved room changes.
metric: Physical footprint and Metal allocated bytes divided by 1048576 (MiB); CPU usage is percent of one CPU core.
limitations: One paired run, baseline first and optimized second. This is a sampled soak, not continuous peak-memory measurement or a statistical performance study.

Both runs used the existing thermal render budget at scale 1 and bloom off because iOS reported serious thermal state (2). Normal quality remains scale 1.5 with bloom. Do not compare these figures directly to earlier 600 MB observations at unknown rendering conditions.
No surface temperature or power measurement was available; reduced CPU load does not by itself prove lower device temperature.
Baseline observedFPS counts SceneEvents.Update callbacks; optimized observedFPS counts completed GPU presentation commands. It is not a direct display-refresh or GPU-time comparison.
The 68 fewer ModelComponents demonstrate scene batching; actual GPU draw-call counts were not captured.
The optimized run captured one local room screenshot near 20 seconds for visual verification. No screenshot or personal doll artwork is included in this report.
